about.title: About VNCANVAS
about.intro: "Hello! I am a child of Vietnam. With a burning passion for my homeland, I created VNCANVAS as a digital canvas to preserve and share the endless beauty of Vietnam with friends around the world."
about.description: This project is a personal endeavor, with the desire to spread the image of the country and the gentle, hospitable Vietnamese people. I hope VNCANVAS will be an inspiration for your upcoming trips.

policy.title: Policy & Terms
policy.nonprofitText: VNCANVAS is a non-profit project. The sole purpose of the website is to promote tourism and the image of Vietnam. We do not charge any fees from users.
policy.copyrightText: All content and images used on the website are for the purpose of introducing the beauty of culture and nature, and are not for commercialization. If you are the owner of an image and want it removed, please contact us.
